description.value: The Twisted Cork is a downtown Prince George restaurant built around the concept of upscale home cooking — tapas and comfort food served alongside wine, craft beer, and cocktails in a relaxed, full-service setting. The venue also houses two banquet spaces seating up to 130 guests and a weather-dependent rooftop patio called La Catrina above the adjacent Black Clover. Its central location in the downtown core makes it a convenient dining stop for cyclists moving through Prince George.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Twisted Cork website is live and confirms the business as an active downtown Prince George restaurant serving tapas, comfort food, wine, craft beer, and cocktails. The banquet page explicitly mentions 'private bathrooms' within the venue, providing positive evidence for washrooms. No bike-specific amenities, wi-fi, charging, or takeout are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those default to null. A postcode discrepancy exists between OSM (V2L 1T7) and the website (V2L 3L1); the website value is used and the discrepancy is flagged.
